title: TheResurrectionTalisman
description: Create a mysterious resurrection talisman and walk the fine line between life and death
body:
EN:
Create a mysterious resurrection talisman and walk the fine line between life and death

Craft:
![crafting recipe](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_262c782c-3ad8-4ee6-92e1-6fb4fcbddf2c.png)

Shard of the soul`s prism drop from Wither with 50% chance


You don't have to hold a talisman in your hands, let it protect you just by being in your inventory.

It is recommended to play with - /gamerule keepInventory false
